components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary committed action with controlled accent brightness.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 2.25rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border-radius: var(--radius-lg); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary) 34%, transparent); background: var(--color-primary-action); color: var(--color-on-brand); font: 500 var(--text-sm)/1.5 var(--font-sans); box-shadow: var(--shadow-brand); transition: background-color var(--transition-fast), border-color var(--transition-fast), transform var(--transition-fast); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-primary-action-hover); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary) 46%, transparent); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Neutral glass action for non-primary choices.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 2.25rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border-radius: var(--radius-lg); border: 1px solid var(--color-border-default); background: var(--color-dark-lighter); color: var(--color-text-primary); font: 500 var(--text-sm)/1.5 var(--font-sans); transition: background-color var(--transition-fast), border-color var(--transition-fast), transform var(--transition-fast); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--color-dark-elevated); border-color: var(--color-border-strong); transform: translateY(-1px); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Compact glass input with token focus ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: var(--spacing-sm); color: var(--color-text-secondary); font: 500 var(--text-sm)/1.35 var(--font-sans); } .ds-input { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; border-radius: var(--radius-lg); border: 1px solid var(--color-border-default); background: var(--color-dark-surface); color: var(--color-text-primary); font: 400 var(--text-sm)/1.5 var(--font-sans); transition: border-color var(--transition-fast), box-shadow var(--transition-fast), background-color var(--transition-fast); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-text-muted); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--color-brand); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--color-focus-ring); }

components.name: Glass Modal
components.html:
设置

多层玻璃表面，文本保持清晰。
components.css: .ds-modal { max-width: 28rem; padding: var(--spacing-lg); border-radius: var(--radius-2xl); border: 1px solid var(--color-glass-border-strong); background: var(--color-modal-surface); color: var(--color-text); box-shadow: var(--shadow-glass-modal); backdrop-filter: blur(var(--glass-blur-modal)); font-family: var(--font-sans); } .ds-modal header { font-size: var(--text-lg); font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: var(--spacing-md); } .ds-modal p { margin: 0; color: var(--color-text-secondary); line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Popover Surface
components.description: Deepest interaction surface for dropdowns and confirmation popovers.
components.css: .ds-popover { display: grid; gap: 0.25rem; min-width: 12rem; padding: 0.45rem; border-radius: var(--radius-xl); border: 1px solid var(--color-glass-border-strong); background: var(--color-popover-surface); box-shadow: var(--shadow-glass-popover); backdrop-filter: blur(var(--glass-blur-popover)); } .ds-popover button { border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-lg); padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; background: transparent; color: var(--color-text-secondary); text-align: left; font: 400 var(--text-sm)/1.4 var(--font-sans); } .ds-popover button:hover { background: var(--color-surface-hover); color: var(--color-text); }

narrative.overview: SimpleTavern is a dense local product surface for long AI roleplay sessions, not a decorative landing page. Its visual system should feel like a quiet cockpit: many controls, panels, logs, and states are available, but the interface stays calm, layered, and legible.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained dark product UI with one theme accent at a time.
Layered glass depth from page canvas to popover.
Compact but readable controls for settings-heavy workflows.

rules.name: The No Gradient Background Rule
rules.body: Visual backgrounds must be translucent solid color. The only allowed gradient is the MVU state bar scanning animation.

rules.name: The Depth Ladder Rule
rules.body: Never choose surface color by eye alone. Map the surface to L0-L6 first, then use the matching token.

rules.name: The Product Sans Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce display fonts into labels, buttons, data, settings, or logs.

dos: Do use translucent solid color surfaces, blur, border, and shadow to express hierarchy.
Do keep every primary action, selection, focus state, and danger state tied to semantic tokens.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion; motion should communicate state changes.
donts: Don't use generic SaaS dashboards with bright gradient cards, decorative glow, and inconsistent button vocabularies.
Don't make the app feel like an overly playful chat app that sacrifices dense configuration clarity.
Don't use glassmorphism as decoration without readability, hierarchy, or performance discipline.
Don't use visual background gradients, except the MVU scanning animation.
